name: Hikari (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Hikari city emblem in white: two stylised running figures of curved strokes with discs.
history: Municipal flag of Hikari, a city in Yamaguchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 12 October 2004; the emblem dates from 4 October 2004.

features.role: Hikari city emblem — two stylised running figures of curved strokes with discs
